json-roundtrip/ — the std json pkg's own bench row (the rut-json
batch, phase 2, survey §2.11's pre-registered method): the SAME
generated document as json-decode (the knucleotide LCG, seed 42 —
same draws, same order), decoded DIRECTLY into typed rows and
re-encoded — encode+decode round trips through the LIB (the trait
path: `impl JsonSerialize/JsonDeserialize for DocRow` in this file,
dispatching json's traits; no hand-rolled twin of the codec).
Module dir because it mounts `json` + `pouch`; the peer gate assembles
group-pouch onto json because pouch is present in this closure (the
Vec rows are load-bearing here). The checksum is defined over the
ROUND-TRIPPED VALUES, not lexemes, and must equal the JS twin's.
name: json_roundtrip
